evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout run 30959460638 on 6dc7ae3, completed successfully; contracts 98-103 applied in one batch. Corroborated read-only: the ledger holds 103 rows through 20260804333000. Contract 103 landed whole — bonus_competitions carries all five lineage columns, both partial indexes exist, and the live-public index predicate reads ((visibility_kind = 'public'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL)); the replaced total key bonus_competitions_tournament_id_game_key_key is gone, and bonus_competitions_predecessor_fkey spans five columns, so a successor cannot retain a predecessor while changing series, season, game or visibility. The backfill is intact: zero non-public rows and zero completed rows, so every existing competition remains the live public instance of its own series and no current reader changes answer. The boundary holds: live_competition_id and prepare_competition_lineage exist only in predictor_internal, neither is present in public, and anon, authenticated and service_role hold no EXECUTE on either. The prepare_competition_lineage trigger is attached, which is the statement the fast lane refused before this run — the apply log records 'trigger "prepare_competition_lineage" ... does not exist, skipping', confirming the drop removed nothing.
